shortDescription: Decision-first trading research and coaching — not buy/sell signals.
fullDescription:
TradeVision AI helps discretionary traders decide what deserves research time. Get a Today brief, setup radar, regime context, journal coaching, chart replay, and an Academy.

Free includes core decision tools, a generous watchlist, and limited AI. Premium unlocks full radar depth, cloud AI coaching (fair-use daily allowance), portfolio intelligence, faster quote updates (polling — not exchange ticks), advanced charts, and data export.

Billing: monthly ($9.99) or yearly ($71.99, ~$5.99/mo) with a 7-day free trial on yearly when available.

Features:
• Decision Brief and setup radar
• AI coaching and analysis
• Portfolio tracking and risk (Premium)
• Price alerts and economic calendar
• Trading Academy with practice links
